The shapes isolate the rule core's `SpecExtend` pair needs once its parent's where-clause-only `T` is inferred (pa31/tests/spec/specialization-fixpoint/core-extend.rs, whose parent equality `I: Iter<Item = T>` this compiler refused as an unimplemented projection-constrained parent argument). Each outcome follows the rule read in the pinned rustc 1.98.0 sources (compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/impl_wf_check/min_specialization.rs `check_always_applicable`, which applies `check_static_lifetimes` and `check_duplicate_params` only to `unconstrained_parent_impl_args`, the parent arguments left after removing every parameter that a constraining position of one of the parent's own associated equalities determines; compiler/rustc_hir_analysis/src/constrained_generic_params.rs `parameters_for`): a repeated or `'static` parent argument that the parent's equality determines is accepted, the same argument without that equality is rejected

repeated-determined.rs.reason: rustc's own `check_duplicate_params` example: `impl<S, I: IntoIter<Item = S>> Tr<S> for I` with child `impl<T> Tr<T> for V<T>`; the parent arguments `[T, V<T>]` repeat `T`, but the parent's equality determines `S`, leaving `[V<T>]`

repeated-undetermined.rs.reason: guard: the same pair over `impl<S, I> Tr<S> for I`, with no equality; `[T, V<T>]` repeats `T`

static-determined.rs.reason: `impl<'a, I: Iter<Item = &'a u8>> Tr for I` with child `impl<I: Iter<Item = &'static u8>> Tr for I`; the parent's equality determines `'a`, so its `'static` argument is not checked

static-undetermined.rs.reason: guard: the same pair over a trait argument, `I: Holds<&'a u8>` and `I: Holds<&'static u8>`; the parent's `'a` is `'static` and is checked

static-marked-determined.rs.reason: `impl<'a, I: Iter<Item = &'a u8>> Tr for I` with child `impl<I: Iter<Item = &'static u8> + Marked> Tr for I`, `Marked` an unsafe specialization marker that orders the pair; the parent's equality determines `'a`, so its `'static` argument is not checked

static-marked-undetermined.rs.reason: guard: the same marked pair over a trait argument, `I: Holds<&'a u8>` and `I: Holds<&'static u8> + Marked`; the parent's `'a` is `'static` and is checked
